DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 案内図をお探しでしょうか。園内でどのようにお過ごしになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a map? How do you plan to spend your time in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真を撮りながら散歩したいです。帰る前の三十分くらいで、この丸い道を一周できると思ったのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰る前の三十分ほどで撮影しながら図の環状の道を一周できると思ったと相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to take a walk and photographs. I thought I could complete this circular route in the thirty minutes or so before I leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought you could complete the loop on the map while taking photographs in about thirty minutes before leaving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図の線が短く見えても、歩く時間とは一致しません。撮影や休憩の時間も含めてお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: A short line on the map does not necessarily correspond to walking time. Have you included time for photographs and breaks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 歩く時間しか考えていませんでした。花を撮っていると止まるので、一周にこだわると戻りが遅くなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歩行時間しか考えておらず、撮影で止まるため一周すると帰りが遅れそうだと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only considered walking time. I stop to photograph flowers, so insisting on the full loop could make me late returning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only considered walking time, and stopping for photographs could make you late returning if you complete the loop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一周せず、途中の休憩所から同じ道を戻る案もあります。図の「木陰の休憩所」を目安にするのはいかがでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You could return along the same path from a rest area partway along instead. How about using the shaded rest area on the map as your landmark?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこまでの往復に変えます。休憩所に着く前でも、時間を見て折り返せるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩所までの往復に変更し、到着前でも時間を見て折り返したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will change to a walk there and back. I also want to be able to turn back before reaching the rest area, depending on the time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will walk to the rest area and back, and want to turn back earlier if necessary after checking the time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのように調整なさってください。お帰りも同じ入口をお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please adjust your walk that way. Will you leave through the same entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入ってきた入口へ戻ります。図では似た印が二つあるので、今いる入口に印を付けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ入口へ帰りたいが図の印が似ているため、現在地の入口に印を付けてほしいと求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will return to the entrance I came through. There are two similar symbols on the map. Could you mark the entrance where we are now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to return to the same entrance, but the map symbols look similar, and ask for the current entrance to be marked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在地はこちらの入口です。この印から休憩所までの線をたどり、戻る時は同じ線を逆に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is our entrance. Follow this line to the rest area, and on your return check the same line in reverse.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 印を付けた入口と往復の道を写真に残します。残り時間を見て、休憩所まで行かずに戻る場合もあると決めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口と往復経路の写真を残し、残り時間次第で休憩所前に折り返すと決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will photograph the marked entrance and the route there and back. I have decided that I may turn back before the rest area depending on the time left.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to photograph the entrance and return route, and turn back before the rest area depending on the time remaining. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 入口と戻る道を確認できましたね。園内の通行案内にも気を配りながら、お楽しみください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have checked the entrance and return route. Enjoy yourself, and also pay attention to the park's route signs. Have a pleasant walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 券売機の確認画面で、操作を止めていらっしゃいますね。何を買うご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have stopped at the ticket machine's confirmation screen. What are you planning to buy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人で日帰りの往復をするので、切符が二枚必要だと思って「二人」を押しました。このまま払ってよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人の往復用に二人を選んだと説明し支払い前に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am making a day return trip alone. I thought I needed two tickets, so I pressed 'two people.' Can I pay now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you selected two people for one person's return trip, and check before paying. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その「二人」は乗る人数です。今の確認画面には、同じ方向の片道を二人分と表示されています。同行の方はいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: 'Two people' means the number of passengers. This screen shows two people's one-way journeys in the same direction. Is anyone traveling with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同行者はいません。行きと帰りを一枚ずつ買うつもりで、人数を増やしてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者はおらず行きと帰りで一枚ずつのつもりだったと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: No one is with me. I meant to buy one ticket out and one back, but increased the passenger count.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct the misunderstanding: you have no companion and intended one ticket each for the outward and return journeys. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだお支払い前なので、今の選択を取り消して最初に戻れます。帰りは同じ経路の予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You have not paid yet, so you can cancel this selection and return to the start. Will you return by the same route?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰りは友人に送ってもらうかもしれません。往復分ではなく、まず行きの片道だけにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰りは友人の車かもしれないため行きの片道だけを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: A friend might drive me back. I would like just the outward single ticket first, rather than tickets both ways.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that a friend might drive you back, so you want only an outward single ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では取り消した後、人数を一人にして、行き先を選び直しましょう。画面が戻ったらご自分で操作なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: After canceling, let's select one passenger and your destination again. Will you operate the machine yourself when the screen returns?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で押してみます。取り消しを押したところで止めるので、最初の画面に戻ったか見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分で取り消しを押し最初の画面に戻ったか見てもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will try pressing it myself. I will stop after pressing cancel. Could you check whether I am back at the first screen?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Press cancel yourself and ask for a check that the first screen has returned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最初の画面に戻っています。選び直した後は、確認画面の「人数」「区間」「片道」を読み上げて確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is back at the first screen. After selecting again, let's read aloud and check the passenger count, journey section, and one-way setting on the confirmation screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一人、ここから目的の駅まで、片道ですね。支払いの前にその三つを読み直し、二人分が残っていないことも見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一人・乗車区間・片道を読み直し二人分の選択が残っていないか支払い前に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: One person, from here to my destination station, one way. Before paying, I will reread those three items and check that the two-person selection is gone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that before paying you will reread one passenger, the journey section, and one way, and check that the two-person selection is no longer there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、選び直した内容を確認してからお支払いください。帰りの切符は今回買わないということで承りました。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, pay after checking your new selection. I understand that you are not buying a return ticket this time. Have a pleasant journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの通知には日付がいくつかありますね。どの点を確かめたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your notice has several dates. What would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申請についての通知です。相談の予約日まで待って返事をすればよいと思っていたのですが、「回答期限」が別にあって心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談予約日とは別の回答期限に気づいて不安だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is a notice about my application. I thought I could wait until my consultation appointment to respond, but I am worried because there is a separate response deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you noticed a response deadline separate from the consultation appointment and are worried. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約日より先に回答期限が書かれていますね。通知が求めているのは来庁ですか、それとも書類の提出ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The response deadline is earlier than the appointment. Does the notice require you to visit the office or submit documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「不足書類を提出」とあります。予約の日に持ってくればよいのかと思いましたが、必要な書類はまだ取り寄せ中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知は不足書類提出を求めておりその書類は取り寄せ中だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says to submit missing documents. I thought I could bring them to the appointment, but I am still obtaining the required documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the notice requests missing documents and you are still obtaining them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談予約をしていても、それだけで回答期限が変わるとは言えません。取り寄せ中という状況を担当へ伝えて相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Having a consultation appointment does not itself mean the response deadline changes. Let's tell the person responsible that you are obtaining the documents and discuss it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 不足している書類名と、まだ届いていないことを先に伝えたいです。届く日は確定していないので、間に合うとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不足書類名と未着を伝え到着日や期限内提出は確約できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to tell them the missing document's name and that it has not arrived yet. Its arrival date is not confirmed, so I cannot say I will meet the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the missing document's name and nonarrival, and that you cannot promise an arrival date or submission by the deadline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点もそのまま伝えます。担当には、書類がそろわない場合の対応と、提出方法を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that on exactly. We need to ask what to do if the documents are incomplete and how to submit them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 提出方法については、郵送なら期限の日に出せばよいのか、その日までに届く必要があるのかを聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 郵送期限が差出日か到着日か担当に尋ねてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: For submission by post, please ask whether I can mail them on the deadline date or they must arrive by that date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to check whether the postal deadline means the mailing date or arrival date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 差し出す日か届く日かも、担当への質問に加えます。予約を残すかどうかは、担当の回答を聞いてから決めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will add that question. Will you decide whether to keep your appointment after hearing the answer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今の予約は勝手に取り消さず、回答期限と郵送の扱い、不足書類への対応を聞いてから、予約も必要か確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約を無断で取り消さず期限・郵送・不足書類の回答後に予約の要否も確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not cancel the current appointment on my own. After hearing about the response deadline, postal requirements, and missing documents, I will check whether the appointment is still needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to keep the appointment for now and check whether it is needed after receiving answers about the deadline, posting, and missing documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では通知を持って担当窓口へご案内します。ここでは期限の変更は確定していません。こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you to the responsible counter with your notice. No deadline change has been confirmed here. This way, please. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらでの受診は初めてですか。まず、お名前と今日困っている症状を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your first visit here? First, may I have your name and the symptoms troubling you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めてです。名前はこちらに書きました。昨日からのどが痛く、話すときも気になるので受診したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初診で氏名を記入済みと伝え昨日からののどの痛みを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, my first visit. I wrote my name here. My throat has hurt since yesterday and bothers me when I speak, so I would like a consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that this is your first visit, you have written your name, and your throat has hurt since yesterday. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 症状をお伝えいただきありがとうございます。今使っている薬や、今回の症状に対して飲んだ薬はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for explaining your symptoms. Are you currently using any medicines, or have you taken any for these symptoms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家にあった薬の箱を持ってきました。ただ、この箱の薬を今回飲んだわけではありません。箱を出すだけでは、飲んだように伝わりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参した箱の薬を今回飲んだわけではなく服用済みと誤解されたくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought a medicine box I had at home. But I have not taken the medicine in this box for this illness. Could showing the box alone make it seem that I have taken it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not taken the boxed medicine for this illness and do not want it mistaken for medicine already taken. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 箱を持っていることと、飲んだかどうかは分けて記録します。今回、実際に飲んだ薬について覚えていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will record having the box separately from whether you took it. What do you remember about medicine you actually took this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日、別の薬を一回飲みました。名前は覚えていませんが、残った袋をかばんに入れてあります。今出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日別の薬を一回飲み名前不明だが残った袋を持っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I took a different medicine once yesterday. I cannot remember its name, but the remaining packet is in my bag. I will take it out now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you took a different medicine once yesterday, do not know its name, but have the remaining packet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その袋も医師が確認できるようお持ちください。名前や服用量がはっきりしない部分は、推測で書かずに記しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep that packet for the doctor to check too. Let's record unclear names or doses without guessing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、問診票には「昨日一回飲んだ、名前と量は要確認」と書きます。こちらの外箱の薬は飲んでいない、と分けて残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実際の服用は名前・量が要確認と書き外箱の未服用薬と分けて記録を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will write 'taken once yesterday; name and amount need checking' on the questionnaire. Please record separately that I have not taken the medicine in this outer box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write that the actual medicine's name and dose need checking, and ask for it to be recorded separately from the untaken boxed medicine. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分けて記載します。資格確認の書類をお持ちであれば、受付の担当者にお出しください。症状と薬の袋はこちらで医師へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record them separately. If you have eligibility verification documents, give them to reception. We will tell the doctor about your symptoms and the medicine packet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ってきた書類は受付担当に出し、薬の袋は診察でも見せます。昨日飲んだ薬をまた飲んでよいかは、自分で決めず医師に尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資格確認書類は受付へ薬袋は診察で提示し再服用の可否は医師に尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give the documents I brought to reception and show the medicine packet during the consultation too. I want to ask the doctor whether I may take yesterday's medicine again, rather than deciding myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that eligibility documents go to reception, you will show the medicine packet during the consultation, and ask the doctor whether to take it again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 服用の相談は診察で医師にお伝えください。受付担当にもおつなぎします。お待ちの間に具合が変わったら職員へ声をかけてください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please discuss taking medicine with the doctor during your consultation. I will also direct you to reception. If your condition changes while waiting, tell a staff member. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お届けいただいたのは、こちらの携帯電話ですね。どこで見つけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the mobile phone you are handing in, correct? Where did you find it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 公園のベンチの近くです。急いでいたので、拾ってからここへ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公園のベンチ近くで拾った携帯電話を届けたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Near a bench in the park. I was in a hurry, so I picked it up and brought it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you are handing in a phone found near a park bench. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 記録には、ベンチとの位置関係も残したいと思います。座面の上、下、周りの地面のうち、どこでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I would like to record its position relative to the bench too. Was it on the seat, underneath, or on the surrounding ground?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 初めはベンチの上だった気がしましたが、持ち上げたときのことを思い出すと、座面の下の地面でした。上ではなく下に直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拾った位置をベンチの上ではなく下の地面に訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: At first I felt it was on the bench, but remembering when I lifted it, it was on the ground under the seat. Please correct 'on' to 'under.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct the location to the ground under the bench, rather than on it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ベンチの下の地面ですね。拾った時刻はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: On the ground under the bench. Do you know what time you picked it up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一時半だと思っていましたが、それは公園を出た後に自分の時計を見た時刻です。拾った瞬間には時計を見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一時半は公園を出た後に見た時刻で拾った時刻は未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought half past one, but that was when I checked my watch after leaving the park. I did not check the time when I picked it up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that half past one was the time checked after leaving the park, and the pickup time is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では一時半ちょうどとせず、その前に拾ったという説明で記録します。拾った電話を操作したことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will record that you picked it up before that, rather than at exactly half past one. Have you operated the phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 触って持ち上げただけです。持ち主を探そうか迷いましたが、画面を操作したり、電話をかけたりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち上げただけで画面操作や発信をしていないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I only touched it to pick it up. I considered looking for the owner, but did not operate the screen or make any calls.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you only picked it up and did not operate the screen or make calls. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 操作はしていないと記録します。説明を読み返しますので、場所と時刻に違いがないか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will record that you did not operate it. I will read the account back, so please check the place and time for mistakes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 場所はベンチの下、時刻は一時半より前で、正確には不明ですね。その二点を区別した記録なら、私の覚えている範囲と合っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所はベンチの下で時刻は一時半より前の正確には不明という記録を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: The location is under the bench, and the time is before half past one but not known exactly. A record distinguishing those points matches what I remember.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the record: under the bench, before half past one, with the exact time unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容でお預かりの手続きをご案内します。届けていただきありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will explain the hand-in procedure on that basis. Thank you for bringing it in. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の郵便物についてですね。今回お引っ越しされたのは、どなたですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about mail after moving, correct? Who has moved this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私だけです。父と母は今の家に残ります。家族の名字が同じなので、郵便もまとめて新住所へ送ってもらうものだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分だけ転居し両親は残るが同姓なので一括転送だと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only me. My parents are staying at the current house. We have the same surname, so I thought all our mail would be forwarded to the new address together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only you moved and your parents stayed, but you thought the shared surname meant all mail would be forwarded together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ名字でも、転居する方と残る方を区別して確認しましょう。ご家族全員が移るという申込みは、まだしていませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even with the same surname, let's distinguish those moving from those staying. You have not yet applied for the entire family to move, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ何も申し込んでいません。両親の郵便まで動かしたくないので、相談では私だけが転居することを最初に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 申込みは未実施で両親の郵便を動かさず本人のみの転居として相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not applied for anything yet. I do not want my parents' mail redirected, so I will say first that only I am moving when I ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not applied yet and will discuss only your own move without redirecting your parents' mail. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新旧の住所と、今回の対象となる方を整理しましょう。今日は住所がわかるものをお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's organize the old and new addresses and who this applies to. Have you brought anything showing your address today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新住所のメモはありますが、本人や旧住所を確認する書類は家です。メモだけで申し込めるかを決めつけず、必要なものを教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所のメモしか持たず本人・旧住所確認書類は家のため必要なものを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a note of the new address, but my identity and old-address documents are at home. I do not want to assume the note is enough to apply; please tell me what I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have only a new-address note, with identity and old-address documents at home, and ask what is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人と住所の確認に必要なものを、担当の案内で確認します。対象者の欄にはご両親を含めないというご希望も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the responsible staff's guidance on identity and address verification. I will also convey that you do not want your parents included in the applicant field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。それから、転送を相談すれば、会社が持っている私の住所も変わるという意味ではありませんよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 郵便の転送相談が会社の登録住所の変更まで意味しないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Also, discussing mail forwarding does not mean that the address my company holds for me will change too, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check that discussing mail forwarding does not also change your company's registered address for you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 会社などが登録している住所の変更は、それぞれの相手への連絡と分けて考えてください。郵便の相談だけで連絡済みにはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Consider address changes held by your company and others separately, with notifications to each organization. Discussing mail alone does not mean they have been notified.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 郵便は私だけの転居として必要な手続きを聞きます。会社へは自分で新住所を知らせ、両親の郵便の扱いとは分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人分の郵便手続きを聞き会社には自分で通知し両親分とは分けて確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask about the mail procedures for my move alone. I will notify my company of my new address myself and check this separately from my parents' mail arrangements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will ask about your own mail procedures, notify your company yourself, and check separately from your parents' mail. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、ご本人だけの転居という条件で担当におつなぎします。今日は申込み完了ではなく、必要事項の確認からです。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to the responsible staff on the basis that only you are moving. Today we are checking the requirements first, not completing an application. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更についてのご相談ですね。新しく申請するところからでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about changing your address. Are you starting a new application?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申請はしたつもりです。でも、旧住所に届いた封筒を家族が転送してくれたので、変更が失敗したのか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所変更を申請したつもりだが旧住所宛の封筒が届き処理を確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I believe I applied. But my family forwarded an envelope that arrived at the old address, so I want to check whether the change failed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you believe you applied for an address change, but an envelope reached the old address, and you want to check processing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申請したときの控えや画面は残っていますか。ここでは、受付されたことと変更が完了したことを分けて見ていきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you still have a receipt or screen from applying? Let's distinguish an application being received from the change being completed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この保存画面には「受付」とあります。「完了」と同じ意味だと思っていましたが、これだけでは変更済みとは言えませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付という保存表示を完了と同じと思っていたが変更済みと判断できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This saved screen says 'received.' I thought that meant 'completed,' but can I tell from this alone that my address has changed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the saved 'received' display meant completion, and ask whether it proves the change is finished. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この文言だけでは処理の完了まで確認できません。届いた通知が作られた時期も、申請前か後かを分ける必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: That wording alone does not confirm completion. We also need to distinguish whether the notice was prepared before or after your application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 申請日と、封筒の中の通知に書かれた日付を並べて見てください。旧住所に届いたという理由だけで、申請が無効だったとは決めたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 申請日と通知日を比較し旧住所への到着だけで申請無効と断定しないよう求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please compare the application date with the date on the notice inside the envelope. I do not want to conclude that the application was invalid merely because it reached the old address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to compare the application and notice dates and not conclude invalidity solely from delivery to the old address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日付と受付情報を整理して、本人確認の後に処理状況を照会します。住所のほかに、今回変更を希望していた項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will organize the dates and receipt information, then check processing after identity verification. Were there any other items you wanted to change besides your address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話番号は変わっていません。今回の相談では住所と通知の送付先を確認し、関係のない項目まで変更しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話は変わらず住所と通知先だけを確認し無関係な変更はしないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: My phone number has not changed. For this consultation, please check only my address and notice delivery address, without changing unrelated items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your phone number is unchanged, and ask them to check only the address and notice destination without unrelated changes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所と送付先の確認として承ります。照会の結果、まだ処理中だった場合は、今後の通知への反映についても確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will handle this as an address and delivery-address check. If the inquiry finds it is still processing, we will also check how future notices will reflect it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では同じ申請をもう一度出す前に、今の受付がどうなっているか調べてください。通知がどの宛先で準備されるのかも、わかる範囲を説明してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 再申請前に今の受付状況を調べ今後通知を準備する宛先をわかる範囲で説明してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please check the current application before I submit the same one again. Also explain, as far as you can determine, which address future notices will be prepared for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the current application status to be checked before reapplying, and for an explanation of the address for future notices as far as known. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人確認のご案内から始めます。現時点では変更完了や今後の到着先を確約せず、照会した内容をお伝えします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will start with identity verification. We cannot promise completion or a future delivery address at this point; we will explain the inquiry results. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのスープの表示で、読みにくいところがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is any part of that soup's label difficult to read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 肉類を避けて選びたいのですが、表には野菜の絵しかありません。裏の原材料も見たいので、この小さい文字を一緒に読んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 肉類を避けたいので野菜の絵だけでなく裏の小さい原材料を一緒に読むよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to avoid meat, but there are only vegetable pictures on the front. I want to check the ingredients on the back too. Could you read these small letters with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to avoid meat, and ask for help reading the small ingredients on the back rather than relying on vegetable pictures. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この原材料欄には、野菜などの後に「チキンエキス」とあります。避けたいものを、もう少し具体的に伺ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This ingredients list says 'chicken extract' after vegetables and other items. Could you tell me more specifically what you wish to avoid?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 肉のかたまりだけでなく、鶏のエキスも避けたいです。野菜スープという名前だけで決めず、この商品は候補から外します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 肉の塊だけでなく鶏エキスも避けるため最初のスープを候補から外す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to avoid chicken extract as well as pieces of meat. I will not judge by the name 'vegetable soup' alone, and will remove this product from my choices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Exclude the first soup because you avoid chicken extract as well as pieces of meat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では別の商品と比較しましょう。こちらは常温棚の商品ですが、先ほどの商品は冷凍の表示もありました。保存設備についてのご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's compare another product. This one is on an ambient shelf, but the previous one was also labeled frozen. Do you have any storage-equipment requirements?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家の冷蔵庫は冷蔵専用で、冷凍はできません。「冷凍」と「冷蔵」を同じだと思わないよう、保存欄も読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 冷蔵庫はあるが冷凍設備を使えず冷凍と冷蔵を区別して保存欄を読みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: My refrigerator only refrigerates; it cannot freeze. I want to read the storage section too, so I do not treat 'frozen' and 'refrigerated' as the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have refrigeration but cannot freeze, and want to distinguish frozen and refrigerated storage while reading the label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この別の商品には「直射日光を避けて常温保存」とあり、その下に「開封後は冷蔵」と続いています。どちらも一緒に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This other product says 'store at room temperature away from direct sunlight,' followed by 'refrigerate after opening.' Please check both together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開ける前と後で条件が変わるのですね。常温保存だけを見て、開けた後も出したままでよいとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開封前後で保存条件が変わり開封後まで常温でよいとは解釈しないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The conditions change before and after opening. I will not read only 'room-temperature storage' and assume I can leave it out after opening too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that storage conditions differ before and after opening and you will not assume room-temperature storage is also allowed after opening. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 原材料についても、この商品には別の記載があります。読めない原材料名が残っている場合は、わからないまま条件に合うとは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This product also has a different ingredients list. If some ingredient names remain unreadable, you cannot judge that it meets your needs while they are still unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は買わず、避けたい原材料名を整理してから選び直します。この商品の原材料欄と、開封後の保存欄を控えてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は購入せず原材料と開封後保存欄を控え避けたい材料を整理して再検討すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not buy anything today. I will organize the ingredient names I want to avoid and choose again. May I note this product's ingredients and after-opening storage instructions?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not buy today, will note the ingredients and after-opening storage instructions, organize what to avoid, and reconsider. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示の内容を控えて確認にお使いください。商品の名前だけでなく原材料と保存条件を比べるということで、今日はお戻しします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please note the label information to use when checking. You will compare ingredients and storage conditions as well as names, so we will put this back today. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 一周路をお探しですか。今日はこちらの掲示も見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the loop trail? Could you also look at today's notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 以前歩いた池の周りを、また一周しようと思っていました。この掲示の色が付いている部分は、何を表していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 以前歩いた池の一周路を希望し掲示の着色部分の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I planned to walk around the pond again as I did before. What does the colored section on this notice mean?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want the pond loop you walked before, and ask what the notice's colored section means. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日はこの部分が補修中で通れません。迂回路はありますが、前と同じ道をそのまま一周することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This section is under repair and closed today. There is a detour, but you cannot complete the same route as before.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日はあまり長く歩けません。迂回して距離が増えるなら、一周する予定を変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 長く歩けないため迂回で距離が増えるなら一周をやめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I cannot walk very far today. If the detour adds distance, I want to change my plan to walk the full loop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot walk far and want to give up the loop if the detour increases the distance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら入口寄りの木陰の道を往復する案があります。池の奥まで行かず、途中で折り返す形です。どのあたりまで歩きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then you could go out and back on the shaded path near the entrance, turning around before the far side of the pond. How far would you like to walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 途中で座って休める場所までにします。座る場所がないまま奥へ行くのは避けたいので、ベンチの位置を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 座って休める場所までにしたいので途中のベンチの位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only as far as somewhere I can sit and rest. I want to avoid going farther without a place to sit, so please show me the benches.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the bench location along the way because you want to go only as far as a seated rest spot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 木陰の道に入って最初の分かれ道の手前に、ベンチがあります。その先の道へ曲がらず、そこで休んで来た道を戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a bench before the first fork after entering the shaded path. You can rest there and return the way you came without turning onto the path beyond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かれ道までは進まず、その手前のベンチで折り返すのですね。池を回る矢印について行かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 分かれ道手前のベンチで折り返し池の周回矢印には従わないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I turn back at the bench before reaching the fork. I will avoid following the arrows for the pond loop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will turn back at the bench before the fork and will not follow the pond-loop arrows. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。帰りも木陰の道からこの入口へ戻る案です。補修場所へ抜けようとせず、通行止めの表示より先には進まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The return route follows the shaded path to this entrance too. Do not try to pass through the repair area or proceed beyond closure signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口からベンチまでの往復に変えます。ベンチに着く前でも疲れたら戻り、一周する道や補修区間には入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口とベンチの往復に替え途中で疲れたら戻り周回路や補修区間には入らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will change to the entrance-to-bench return walk. I will return sooner if tired, and will not enter the loop or repair section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will walk between the entrance and bench, return sooner if tired, and avoid the loop and repair section. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日はその短い往復にして、体調に合わせてお戻りください。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-43216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take that short return walk today and return according to how you feel. Have a pleasant walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 出口へのご案内でしょうか。お荷物を持ったまま、どちらへ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need directions to the exit? Where are you heading with your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 列車を降りたところです。東口で家族が待っていますが、この大きいケースを持って階段を下りるのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 降車直後で東口の家族に合流したく、大きなケースを持って階段を下りるのを避けたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have just got off the train. My family is waiting at the east exit, but I want to avoid taking the stairs down with this large case.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have just left the train, want to join family at the east exit, and wish to avoid descending stairs with a large case. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この図では、目の前の階段のほかにエレベーターを通る経路があります。お迎えの方は、出口を変えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This map shows a route using an elevator as well as the stairs in front of you. Can the people meeting you change exits?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族は東口に車を止めているそうなので、合流する出口は変えないで行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の車が東口にあるため、合流出口を変更せずに行きたいと答える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My family says their car is parked at the east exit, so I want to keep that as our meeting exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the family car is at the east exit, so you want to keep the same meeting exit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでは東口までの経路を確認します。エレベーターを経由すると、階段の経路より回り道になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's check the route to the east exit. Going via the elevator is a longer way around than using the stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 近さより階段を使わないことを優先します。家族には、回り道をするので少し待ってほしいと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 近道より階段を使わない経路を選び、回り道で待ってほしいと家族へ連絡すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Avoiding stairs matters more than the shortest route. I will tell my family I am taking a detour and ask them to wait a little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose avoiding stairs over a shortcut, and explain that you will ask your family to wait because of the detour. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この矢印に沿ってエレベーターへ向かい、下りてから有人の改札へ進む線です。図の向きは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Follow this arrow to the elevator, go down, then follow this line to the staffed ticket gate. Do you understand the map's orientation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今いるのがこの丸印ですね。エレベーターを下りてから改札へ行くので、先に階段へ向かうのではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在地の丸印を確認し、先に階段前へ行くのではなくエレベーターの後で改札へ向かう順序を確かめる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This circle is where I am now. I go to the gate after taking the elevator down, rather than heading to the stairs first, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify the current-location circle and check the sequence: elevator first, then ticket gate, without first heading to the stairs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、この図ではその順序です。実際の表示も見て、分からなくなったら止まって係員にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-44204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, that is the order on this map. Check the actual signs too, and if you become unsure, stop and ask a staff member.
